paite: Huchi in Abijah bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, David khopi ah avui ua, asik in atapa Asa in vai ahawmta hi. Avaihawm sung in agam uh kum sawm galmuang in a-om hi.
heading: Kumpipa Asa In Ethiopiate Azou
english: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Asa his son reigned in his place. In his days, the land was quiet ten years.

paite: Asa in TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih leh thil dik ahih gige hi.
english: Asa did that which was good and right in Yahweh his God’s eyes,

paite: Gamdang pathian maitamte leh mun sangte alamang a, suangphuhte ahihchim a, Asherah songte aphuk hi.
english: for he took away the foreign altars and the high places, broke down the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles,

paite: Judahte TOUPA apipute uh Pathian zong ding leh adan leh athupiak zui ding in thu apia hi.
english: and commanded Judah to seek Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and to obey his law and command.

paite: Huan Judahte khua tengteng a mun sangte leh milimte alamang vek a; amah nuai ah agam galmuang in a-om hi.
english: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the sun images; and the kingdom was quiet before him.

paite: Judah gam ah kulh nei khopite abawl a, gam galmuang in a-om a, huai kumte in kidouna anei kei; TOUPA'N galmuanna apiak ziak in.
english: He built fortified cities in Judah; for the land was quiet, and he had no war in those years, because Yahweh had given him rest.

paite: Judahte kiang ah, "Hiai khuate bawlpha nawn ni e, kulh in um lehang, insangte, kulh kongkhakte, akalhnate bawl ni: TOUPA i Pathian i zon tak ziak un gam i nuai uah ahong omta ahi: amah i zong ua, ama'n kil chih ning chih a galmuang a omna hon peta ahi,” achi hi. Huchi in abawlhoih ua, alamzang zelta uhi.
english: For he said to Judah, “Let’s build these cities and make walls around them, with towers, gates, and bars. The land is yet before us, because we have sought Yahweh our God. We have sought him, and he has given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered.

paite: Asa in Judah mi lum leh tei tawimi sepaih nuaithum anei a: Benjamin mi phaw leh thal zangmi nuainih-le-singgiat; hiai tengteng mihat hangsan vek ahi uhi.
english: Asa had an army of three hundred thousand out of Judah who bore bucklers and spears, and two hundred eighty thousand out of Benjamin who bore shields and drew bows. All these were mighty men of valor.

paite: Huan Ethiopia mi Zerah, sepaih maktaduaikhat leh kangtalai zathum toh amau sual ding in ahong kuan a; Mareshah ahong tung hi.
english: Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah.

paite: Huchi in asual ding in Asa ava kuan a, Mareshah ah Zephathah Phaizang ah akiphalh uhi.
english: Then Asa went out to meet him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

paite: Asa in TOUPA a Pathian asam a, "TOUPA kia lou ngal mihattak lak a hat lou panpih a-om kei a; aw TOUPA ka Pathian uh, hon panpih ve; nang hon muang in na min in hiai mipite ka hong sual uhi. Aw TOUPA, ka Pathian uh na hi a, mihing in nang hon zou kei uhen,” achi hi.
english: Asa cried to Yahweh his God, and said, “Yahweh, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has no strength. Help us, Yahweh our God; for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this multitude. Yahweh, you are our God. Don’t let man prevail against you.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Asa leh Judahte ma ah Ethiopia mite asual a; Ethiopia mite ataikekta uhi.
english: So Yahweh struck the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.

paite: Asa leh aheute'n Gerar tan in adelh ua, Ethiopia mite asih tam mahmah ziak un apang thei kei ua; TOUPA leh asepaihte ma ah vuallelhsak in a-omta ua; gallak tampi ala uhi.
english: Asa and the people who were with him pursued them to Gerar. So many of the Ethiopians fell that they could not recover themselves, for they were destroyed before Yahweh and before his army. Judah’s army carried away very much booty.

paite: Gerar kim a khua tengteng asual ua, TOUPA launa atung uah a-om a, khua tengteng alok ua, gallak atam ngial hi.
english: They struck all the cities around Gerar, for the fear of Yahweh came on them. They plundered all the cities, for there was much plunder in them.

paite: Ganpute' puaninte leng asual ua, belam leh sangawngsau tampi ahawl ua, Jerusalem ah apai nawnta uhi.
english: They also struck the tents of those who had livestock, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, then returned to Jerusalem.
